hook: You sit down to work and forty minutes pass without a single coherent thought
topic: Brain fog is a biological state, not a character flaw
body:
**You sit down to work. You know exactly what needs to get done. And then — nothing. Forty minutes pass and the screen looks exactly the same as when you opened it.**

That moment has a name. And it is not laziness, and it is not burnout, and it is not your personality.

What you are experiencing is a functional impairment in the operating conditions of your brain. The hardware is intact. The neurons are there. What's degraded is the biochemical environment in which your brain is trying to work.

Think of a high-performance engine running on degraded fuel at the wrong temperature. The engine is not broken. The conditions are wrong. That is what brain fog is — not a structural problem with your brain, but a state produced by specific, identifiable inputs.

Which means it has a cause. And a fix.

The version of you that thinks clearly and finishes what you start — that is your default. Brain fog is the deviation.

Follow for the mechanisms.
